title: The latest Aaron Rodgers media tour says plenty about his respect for Mike McCarthy (and Mike Tomlin)

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: The latest Aaron Rodgers media tour says plenty about his respect for Mike McCarthy (and Mike Tomlin)
sources.description: One of the best things about flying home from Seattle on Thursday was that I didn't have the time (if I would have even had the inclination) to observe the latest bout of verbal diarrhea from Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers.
